remarks: Freshly painted and just refinished the floors with beautifully maintained this elegant townhouse-style 3BR home offers comfort and convenience. Situated next to Bruce Park and just a short walk to the train, Greenwich Avenue's restaurants, shops, and the Bruce Museum. Features include an attached garage, spacious and sunlit interiors, primary bedroom suite with cathedral ceiling, walk-in closet, specious primary bathroom, renovated hall bathroom, eat-in-kitchen with stainless-steel appliances and private outdoor patio access with doors from living room.
